data.title: 五河琴里 · 浴室暖雾中的娇小水影
data.description: 水汽氤氲的热水浴室中，粉色的小浴巾包裹在琴里娇嫩的身躯上。湿透的红色长发搭在精致白皙的小锁骨前，双脚轻点在温水池边。暖雾熏烤得她浑身泛着粉红色的健康色泽，她双手按在浴池边沿，红宝石般的眸子泛起一层薄薄的水汽，带着几分小恶魔般的娇嗔与少女初萌的私密羞涩。
data.location: steamy home cedar bathtub filled with aromatic bath salts
data.action: sitting on edge of bathtub wrapped in pink bath towel, wet red twintails sticking to bare shoulders, flushed skin from hot bath, pouting cutely with glistening ruby eyes
data.lighting: soft diffused warm bathroom glow illuminating rising steam vapors
data.mood: delicate innocent vulnerability, adorable playful gap
data.promptProse: Sitting on the edge of a steamy bathtub wrapped in a pink towel, Kotori looks back with wet red twintails. Droplets glisten on her flushed shoulders as she pouts with cute, innocent bashfulness in the warm vapor.
data.animaCaption: Kotori wrapped in a pink towel beside a steamy bath, pouting cutely with flushed cheeks.
